protocol.sampling: All eight released Amazon scaffolds, first seven canonical task indices; no outcome-based selection
protocol.domain: All directed routes; all unlabelled partitions into at most three cells; every modal route duration <= L
protocol.horizon: L=1.2 times the exact minimum modal bottleneck, before endpoint objectives
protocol.scale: Exact minimum modal workload on the common modal-feasible domain
protocol.common_support: Every completion has the same original lower support a, mode b and upper support c; the common left branch is linear from (a,0) to (b,1). Only the right branch is used on modal-feasible routes.
protocol.uncertainty: Constructed stress scenarios; only modal inputs are operational; no new human data or uncertainty calibration
protocol.triangular_baseline: Linear interpolation from b,c, without fitting interior endpoints; deliberate representation convention

hidden_test_completions.formula: Between each pair of adjacent full-grid endpoints use q_lo-(q_lo-q_hi)*z^[p*(1+.12*(leg_id%3-1))]
hidden_test_completions.separation: All full-grid values are shared; interior interpolations are used only after optimization to evaluate every method against an exact oracle on the same domain

protocol.cap_policy: Apply the same endpoint-certified worst-cell cap to triangular, minimax and exact-sweep methods within each grid; retain infeasibility
protocol.regret: Test objective minus exact test optimum on the identical grid/policy feasible set; cap cost separately versus uncapped
protocol.sweep: Every attainable upper-risk ceiling, exact minimum workload, then minimum upper OWA
protocol.inference: Descriptive eight-route experiment; repeated alpha/grid/weight/completions are not independent samples
protocol.timing: No time-limited or comparative timing experiment

extension.name: Endpoint information add-on v11
extension.freeze_scope: These extension choices were recorded before executing the additional stress evaluations, after inspecting the original three-completion experiment; this is not preregistration.
extension.selection: All eight original inputs, both original grids, both policies, both weight profiles and all three alpha values; no outcome-based exclusions.
extension.original_methods: Preserve all 576 original selected plans and their original smooth-test values.
extension.piecewise_linear: Optimize the single completion that linearly interpolates q_e between the endpoints available on the selected grid, using the original domain, workload scale, cap, profiles and preferences.
extension.stress_choice: Fixed reciprocal powers, symmetric on a log scale around one; selected before viewing their outcomes, without tuning.
extension.completion_formula: On each adjacent full-grid endpoint interval use q_lo-(q_lo-q_hi)*z**[p*(1+0.12*(leg_id%3-1))]. All methods are evaluated under the identical completion and same policy-specific oracle.
extension.aggregation: Keep original smooth-three means/maxima separate from each additional stress power. Do not average all five as an empirical distribution.
extension.least_favourable: For each grid separately, the common least-favourable endpoint completion gives J=upper_J; report it as a deterministic robust certificate, not an independent empirical win.
extension.primary_outputs: Main 16-row method table for original smooth family; supplementary weights/routes with PL and separate stress table; matched grid changes and robust gaps.
limitations: Constructed memberships and completion families are not calibrated operational uncertainty.
A smooth completion family may favour point interpolation.
Repeated settings are descriptive and not independent replications.
No universal superiority of point interpolation or minimax is claimed.
